description: All welcome. All you need is interest
summary: It is the educational base building game. It contains resource management, building structures and dealing with issues. As it was needed to game is really easy to navigate, contains guides and easy words, making it suitable for children aged 7-12. It teaches kids on how future planet inhabitation work in easy way.
details: It is just a simple base building game. Main goal is being able to develop your base to some point(build 10 habitats) . if resources are depleted and in 30 days wont be recovered you will lose. Used tools: Unity software, c# code language
